name: chip
title: Chip
description: A small pill for one short value: a filter that is on and can be removed, a suggestion to press, or one of a set of choices that can be switched on and off.

meta.when: Filters in effect above a list (Chip with ChipRemove), suggested replies or refinements under a message or a search (ChipButton), and choosing one or several short options such as moods, tags or times of day (ChipGroup). For a status that cannot be pressed use badge; for two to five views of the same thing use segmented-control; for long labels use checkboxes or radio-group.
